title: On the sly: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 42

## On the sly

**Word Power 42 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Secretly.

### Usage

1. I remember when I was a student smoking in school was forbidden, but we used to do it on the sly in the lavatories.
2. Papa drinks wine on the sly because mom doesn't want him to drink.

### How to use it

On the sly means secretly, usually because someone wants to avoid notice or disapproval. The phrase describes how an action is performed. It is informal and can carry a slightly disapproving tone.

### Another example

He checked the match score on the sly while the others were discussing homework.

### Check your understanding

Choose: She took an extra biscuit ___. (on the sly / in the sly)

### Suggested answer

On the sly. Keep the article the and the preposition on; this is a fixed adverbial phrase.
